title: As disasters mount, next UN climate summit faces a test of trust
content:
Less than a month before the UN climate conference COP31 opens in Antalya, Türkiye, representatives of three successive summit presidencies gathered to address a pressing question: How can the world restore trust in climate action when the consequences of a warming planet are already being felt? title: WHO urges vigilance after Kenya confirms second Ebola case
content:

title: DR Congo: Cholera cases spike amid fight against Ebola
content:
The cholera epidemic continues to spread in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), where more than 125,000 suspected cases and 3,644 suspected deaths were recorded between January 2025 and the end of September 2026, the World Health Organization (WHO) warned on Wednesday.
